comment: Every ERROR code and what a client's outbox does with a commit refused under it. Read by lib/src/sync/outbox.rs (Rust) and browser/lib/src/local-outbox.test.ts (TypeScript), so the two cannot disagree. Add a row for every new code in protocol.rs `error_code` and ws-v2.ts `ErrorCode`; never renumber or reuse. disposition: retry = back off and send again (the default, and what a code the outbox does not know gets); park = keep the entry but stop retrying until a fresh edit; drop = the write can never apply, remove it. benign: a drop that loses nothing (log it, no toast). snapshot: retry with the whole snapshot, not the delta. settlesDestroy: for a destroy the refusal is an acknowledgement.
